verdicts.quote: All-or-nothing. One bad row rejects the whole file; nothing is created. Chosen because it makes retry and replay trivial to reason about.
422 {"status":"rejected","total_rows":N,"created_count":0,"errors":[{"row":R,"field":"email|name|row","code":"…","message":"…"},…]}
A row whose email already belongs to a user is an error, not a skip or an update. / email already used earlier in this file (by normalized value) → EMAIL_DUPLICATE_IN_FILE, carrying first_row
No role, password, group or other column is importable. / A CSV can never make an admin. ... every user created by an import has role member
The import page and the API are available only to a signed-in user whose current role is admin. The role is evaluated on every request

First line is a header; after trimming and ASCII case-folding it must be exactly email and name, each once, in either order. ... header not as above (missing, extra, duplicate or unknown column) → 400 HEADER_INVALID

comma-separated values with RFC 4180 quoting, LF or CRLF line ends, optional UTF-8 BOM (ignored) ... not valid UTF-8 → 400 ENCODING_INVALID; name contains a control character ... embedded line break → NAME_INVALID
After any failure: U exactly, unchanged, including no partially created user and no orphan side records. / no credential, and no email is sent
size over max_bytes → 413 FILE_TOO_LARGE ... more data rows than max_rows → 413 ROW_LIMIT_EXCEEDED ... Open gap G-3 (user decision): the production values
verdicts.missing: The actual production values of the row and byte limits are left undecided.

verdicts.quote: FX-6 → 400 FILE_EMPTY ... FX-5 → 400 NO_ROWS ... a one-row file (FX-3) creates exactly one user
Re-uploading a file that already succeeded creates nothing and reports EMAIL_EXISTS for every row. Left out: import idempotency keys or "skip existing" retries (D-4)
Outcome is known when the response arrives. No pending server-side state after the response. / No background job, queue or polling endpoint.
Imported users get the product's default non-admin role, no credential, and no email is sent (G-2).
the default non-admin role, a store-assigned id, and no credential ... Open gap G-2 (user decision): how imported users obtain credentials
verdicts.missing: How imported users first sign in, and whether they are active or pending (status field left to G-1).

verdicts.quote: Upload bytes: request lifetime, readable by the handler only, removed on every exit (including temp storage).
Only email and name. ... Left out: other delimiters (semicolon, tab), other encodings ... IDN/punycode or Unicode normalization of emails (non-ASCII is kept as written)
verdicts.missing: No explicit statement on locale-dependent value formats; handled only implicitly by restricting columns to email and name.

verdicts.quote: writes exactly one audit event: actor id (absent if unauthenticated), UTC time, outcome ..., total_rows when parsed, created_count, file size in bytes
the client aborts the connection ... store read-back is S-0 or S-0 plus all three users, never one or two; if all three exist, a resubmit gives the R-6.2 result.
verdicts.missing: Whether the admin has any cancel control for a running import; retrying only failed rows is only implied by all-or-nothing re-send.

verdicts.quote: The maximum rows and file size, and with them a latency target, are not given and are not invented here. / an indeterminate progress indicator appears (no percentage)
verdicts.missing: The time bound for a maximum-size file; progress is only an indeterminate indicator.

verdicts.quote: S-0's three users unchanged. ... Left out: updating or deactivating existing users
verdicts.missing: Whether the existing single-user creation flow stays unchanged is never stated.

verdicts.quote: A name starting with =, +, - or @ is stored verbatim; neutralizing it for spreadsheet export is excluded ... Open gap G-6 (prerequisite): a maximum name length (code would be NAME_TOO_LONG)
verdicts.missing: The maximum name length, and so how an over-long name field is handled.
